name: Recognition Hunger
description: Not fame, just someone who sees what they actually did
behavioral_signature: Works tirelessly hoping someone will notice and acknowledge their effort
under_stress: Becomes bitter when contributions go unrecognized
at_rest: Dependable, hardworking, quietly hoping for acknowledgment
will_always: do excellent work and hope it speaks for itself
will_never: stop caring whether their work is seen
unless: the work itself becomes the reward and they let go of the audience
